hints.title: Two speeds
hints.body: Use two pointers that move through the list at different rates.

hints.title: Floyd's idea
hints.body: Move one pointer one step and the other two steps. In a cycle the faster pointer eventually laps the slower one.

hints.title: Termination
hints.body: If the faster pointer reaches the end, there is no cycle.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
slow = head, fast = head
while fast and fast.next:
    slow = slow.next
    fast = fast.next.next
    if slow is fast: return true
return false
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
